From Portugal, you will contribute to engineering projects for a Dutch customer, while being part of an international and growing engineering environment. We offer: Between 2000 and 2750 A challenging engineering role in offshore, marine and heavy lifting technology; Theopportunity to work for a leading Dutch company in high-end crane and hoisting equipment; A professional workplace in the Porto region; International collaboration with experienced engineers in the Netherlands; Room to grow technically and professionally; A role where your work directly contributes to safe and reliable lifting systems; Support from Xelvin Portugal during your onboarding and development. Functie-eisen We are looking for an engineer with a strong technical mindset and a practical approach to electrical design. Experience in heavy lifting or offshore/marine equipment is a plus, but not mandatory. Relevant experience in machine building, industrial automation, material handling, shipbuilding or heavy equipment is also highly valuable. You bring: At least 2 years of experience as an Electrical Design Engineer, EPLAN Engineer or similar; Good experience with EPLAN; A technical background in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics or a similar field; Experience with electrical schematics, control cabinets, cable lists, terminal diagrams and BOMs; Knowledge of industrial components such as drives, sensors, motors, safety relays, PLC I/O and control systems; An interest in working on cranes, hoisting systems and heavy lifting equipment; Good communication skills in English; A structured and accurate way of working; The ability to work independently while staying connected to an international project team.
